metrics.quality_denominator_policy: Target500 on every dataset/method. Do not publish partial official scores or a scorable-count column while recovery remains possible. Only after confirmed inability to reach500 disclose actual n, reasons and missingness bounds; never label n<500 as a500 score.
metrics.local_time: Sum measured local component input-to-complete-output processing time; exclude queue, waiting for inputs and first load. Include applicable local decomposition; audit old timing measurement scope before reuse.
metrics.API_time: Client request-send to first nonempty content token, not first role/heartbeat frame; includes network/provider wait. Record separately from local time, never call it pure inference or total end-to-end time.
metrics.query_TTFT_summary: Sum the TTFTs of applicable new live logical model stages per original query; missing/cached timings remain unknown, not zero. Preserve stage values and cache origin; no call count column.
metrics.summary: Per dataset mean F1/EM, mean local processing seconds, mean summed client TTFT, mean input/output tokens, mean logical estimated CNY; applicable measurement coverage noted when incomplete.
metrics.tokens: Per-component model-tagged input/output counts; distinguish API usage and local decomposition tokens. Reused logical usage is not new billed usage.
metrics.cost: Logical complete-method estimate and incremental returned-usage expenditure separate; unknown reserves retained; no invented GPU CNY.
